body.condition: Conditional on \(\mathcal D_{A,k}\), the calibration observations are independent and, for every unit vector \(u\in\mathbb R^{J_n}\), the centered variables \(X_{i,u}=(u^\top\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k,A)}(O_i))^2-E[(u^\top\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k,A)})^2\mid\mathcal D_{A,k}]\) and \(Z_{i,u}=u^\top\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k,A)}(O_i)\widehat B^{(-k,A)}(O_i)-E[u^\top\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k,A)}\widehat B^{(-k,A)}\mid\mathcal D_{A,k}]\) satisfy \(E[\exp(\lambda X_{i,u})\mid\mathcal D_{A,k}]\le\exp(C\lambda^2B_{D,n}^4)\) for \(|\lambda|\le c/B_{D,n}^2\) and \(E[\exp(\lambda Z_{i,u})\mid\mathcal D_{A,k}]\le\exp(C\lambda^2B_{D,n}^2B_{0,n}^2)\) for \(|\lambda|\le c/(B_{D,n}B_{0,n})\), with fixed positive constants \(c,C\).

novel.justification: The independent calibration layer and its conditional exponential-moment convention are explicit estimator-side conditions needed for a learned singular Gram.
